For optimal care of pineapple plants (*Ananas comosus*), provide full sun to encourage healthy growth and fruit production. Pineapples thrive in warm temperatures between 65-95°F (18-35°C) and prefer moderate humidity. Use well-draining, slightly acidic soil with a pH of 4.5-6.5. Water sparingly, ensuring the soil dries slightly between waterings, as pineapples are drought-tolerant and sensitive to overwatering. Fertilize every 6-8 weeks with a balanced, water-soluble fertilizer like 10-10-10, or one specifically formulated for tropical plants, to support growth and fruit development. Prune any dead leaves to keep the plant healthy and tidy. With patience and proper care, a pineapple plant will reward you with a sweet, homegrown fruit in about 18-24 months.
